## Industry Experience

::: {.wm-cv-item}
[Fall 2024]{.wm-cv-when}

**Student Internship, RTX**\
Worked with a student and an RTX mentor to benchmark implementations of the three NIST standardized cryptographic algorithms (FIPS 203, 204, and 205). Gathered implementation requirements and commercial acquisition data for FIPS 140-3 and CNSA 2.0 compliant cryptographic modules. Wrote a report comparing the performance of several libraries and outlining the FIPS 140-3 and CNSA 2.0 requirements for cryptographic modules.
:::
